sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (quality row grading_wiring_is_structurally_correct; related deterministic rows on judge.toml validity/layout; workbook has no comment/threaded-comment parts)
evidence: scoring.toml, test.sh and tools/ are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff clean); scoring.toml has [gates] render/constraints=0.0, [weights] functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2 (sum 1.0), [floors] functional 0.05, and every name maps to tests/gates/<name> or tests/scored/<name>. All five judge.toml files parse with tomllib; their [judge] headers match the template (judge="claude-code", mode=batched, isolated=false, prompt_template=prompt.md, no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight; timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900, each below its suite budget 1500/11100, and 1500+11100=12600 < verifier timeout_sec 13200). Each declares the playwright MCP server with the template args; only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 adds the verifier server ['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py', '$APP_RESTART_HELPER'], matching test.sh:193 `export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh"` exported before run_suite (test.sh:203-227). Gates use all_pass with binary criteria (render 1, constraints 2); scored use weighted_mean (functional 43 binary, polish 6 binary, visual 3 likert with points=5); ids are unique and equal names, weights positive (1.0/1.5/2.0), descriptions non-empty. Every prompt.md contains exactly one {criteria} and one {app_context} (substituted by test.sh from app_context.md) and no other placeholders. restart_app is named only by cw_save_reload_restart (functional judge.toml:344) and gated as single-use in functional prompt.md:33 and restart_mcp.py marker. Adversarial checks: a dead app cannot pass because gates are all_pass and floors require functional>0.05; a conforming app is not structurally penalised since no criterion other than the restart one depends on the verifier tool. Note: no configured-judge run exists for these v16 bytes (raw-evidence-index scope); that is a workload/launch evidence gap tracked by other rows, not a structural defect here, and the unchanged template headers were exercised by the v15 hosted run.
